decisions.reason: It is adjacent to our GeoIT integration capabilities and, despite some overlap risk with other identity offerings, its stronger 2024 positioning suggests enough learning and improvement potential to retain it.
An open GIS application framework sits very close to our core knowledge base in extensible geospatial software and standards work, so we can continue to absorb feedback and improve it commercially.
This identity and access service fits our strategic direction of embedding GeoIT in existing enterprise systems, and our integration expertise makes it a highly absorbable and improvable offering.

The consulting workshop is strongly aligned with our established advisory and training strengths and helps generate customer insight for follow-on GeoIT projects, so it is worth keeping unless demand disappoints.
